import ctypes,hashlib,importlib.util,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('prepare_hash','scripts/three-d-learned-prepare.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
mode=sys.argv[1];source=Path(sys.argv[2]);started=time.perf_counter()
checksum=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if mode=='before' else module.file_sha256(source)
elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
class Memory(ctypes.Structure):
 _fields_=[('cb',ctypes.c_ulong),('faults',ctypes.c_ulong)]+[(name,ctypes.c_size_t) for name in ['peak','working','quotaPeakPaged','quotaPaged','quotaPeakNonPaged','quotaNonPaged','pagefile','peakPagefile']]
mem=Memory();mem.cb=ctypes.sizeof(mem)
k=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32');k.GetCurrentProcess.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
p=ctypes.WinDLL('psapi');p.GetProcessMemoryInfo.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_ulong]
assert p.GetProcessMemoryInfo(k.GetCurrentProcess(),ctypes.byref(mem),ctypes.sizeof(mem))
print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'sha256':checksum,'elapsedMs':elapsed,'peakWorkingSetBytes':mem.peak}))
